Package io.jengacode.eduvideo.animation

Class PathTrack

java.lang.Object
io.jengacode.eduvideo.animation.PathTrack
All Implemented Interfaces:
Animation
public final class PathTrack extends Object implements Animation
One property sampled from a pure path. Three coordinated tracks provide position and optional tangent orientation; scale, opacity and glow remain independent timeline properties.

    • PathTrack

      public PathTrack(MotionPath path, Property property, double start, double duration, Easing easing)
      Binds X, Y or ROTATION to a path over a finite positive interval.
      Parameters:
      path - pure path sampler or file path, as specified by this operation
      property - property driven by this track
      start - nonnegative interval start in scene-local seconds (global seconds for audio cues)
      duration - positive interval length in seconds
      easing - normalised interpolation curve

    • follow

      public static void follow(SceneObject target, MotionPath path, double start, double duration, boolean orient)
      Attaches coordinated position and optional rotation tracks, rejecting property conflicts.
      Parameters:
      target - object or zero-based row receiving the operation
      path - pure path sampler or file path, as specified by this operation
      start - nonnegative interval start in scene-local seconds (global seconds for audio cues)
      duration - positive interval length in seconds
      orient - whether to rotate the object to follow the path tangent
